title: When the facts change, the law must too
text: The Supreme Court said two-child laws have lost relevance because fertility fell from 3 to 1.9; it quoted the idea that survival belongs to the 'most responsive to change', and noted that China could not raise births at will after ending its one-child policy.
use: For 'You cannot step twice in the same river' (2022) and 'Shelving hard decisions is the least ethical course' (2026).

title: Jamsetji Tata's steel plant
text: When Jamsetji Tata applied to the imperial government in 1912 to set up a steel plant, a British official sneered that Indians simply could not do it. Permission was given and Tata succeeded. Today, writers ask whether he would have wanted the mix of duties and quality-control orders that now shield Indian steel.
use: For 'A ship in harbour is safe, but that is not what a ship is for' (2022) and 'Courage to accept and dedication to improve are two keys to success' (2019).
